projectState.summary: Track A1 is implemented on codex/byte-a1-candidate-store from main. The branch adds a bounded Candidate contract, SQLite schema v3 candidates table, server/client write/query/score/retain/purge/cap APIs, candidate.created/scored/retained/purged audit events, db smoke coverage, and middleware smoke coverage. It is inspect-only: no audio, model, generator loop, or playback path consumes candidates. Validation: build green, db:smoke green, smoke 40/40, diff-check green; npm audit still reports the known Vite/esbuild dev-server advisories.
